record.label: Symbolic costs of arithmetic and lookup rotations
record.statement: The paper attributes the lower $T$ count to the inner-product lookup circuits and the reuse of ancillas. Of the $3{,}698$ $T$ gates it reports, $3{,}104$ come from 776 temporary ANDs and 594 from 41 inner-product gadgets.
record.boundary: The 776 temporary AND and relative-phase Toffoli operations contribute $3{,}104$ of the $3{,}698$ symbolic $T$ gates. The first lookup pass has 26 gadgets with 364 entries in their phase lists. The second has 15 gadgets with 230 entries. Each entry accounts for one $T$ or $T^\dagger$ gate.
